Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.celebration

Class VictoryCelebrationEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.ZentrixEvent
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.ZentrixGameEvent
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.celebration.VictoryCelebrationEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
public final class VictoryCelebrationEvent extends ZentrixGameEvent implements org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
Called when a won match is about to celebrate, with the celebration each winner will play.

getCelebrations() maps every winner still in the match to the ID of the celebration they will play - their own choice or the server's default. Listeners may give a winner another existing celebration through setCelebration(UUID, String) or keep one from celebrating through removeWinner(UUID); winners cannot be added. Cancelling plays no celebration at all. The win announcement and the match's restart are not affected either way.

Main thread; only fired while a listener is registered.

Since:
1.8.0
